title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting Lord Rama as the living embodiment of righteousness
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting Lord Rama as the living embodiment of righteousness, truth, and valour.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
"रामो विग्रहवान्  धर्मस्साधुस्सत्यपराक्रमः। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानां मघवानिव॥"
Lord Rama is the living embodiment of righteousness itself. He is the ultimate refuge of the virtuous, unwavering in his resolutions, and steadfast in his truthful valour. He is the sole ruler of this entire universe, who governs and protects all realms in the exact same manner as Lord Indra rules and protects the entire celestial domain.
रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मस्साधुस्सत्यपराक्रमः।

राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानां मघवानिव॥ https://t.co/up7GplXzTg — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 20, 2026
